before.test/counter_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule CounterTest do
  use ExUnit.Case
  test "adding changes the value" do
    {:ok, pid} = Counter.start_link()
    on_exit(fn -> if Process.alive?(pid), do: Agent.stop(pid) end)
    Counter.add(pid, 2)
    assert Counter.value(pid) == 2
  end
end

after.test/counter_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule CounterTest do
  use ExUnit.Case
  test "adding changes the value" do
    {:ok, pid} = Counter.start_link()
    on_exit(fn -> if Process.alive?(pid), do: Agent.stop(pid) end)
    Counter.add(pid, 2)
    assert Counter.value(pid) == 2
   assert :sys.get_state(pid) == %{value: 2}
  end
end
